name: When should I consider replacing missing siding versus repairing it?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing missing siding versus repairing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to replace or repair missing siding depends on the extent of the damage, the age of the existing siding, and its overall condition. If only a few panels are missing due to a specific event, a repair might be sufficient. However, if multiple sections are missing across different areas, or if the remaining siding shows signs of widespread deterioration, a full replacement could be more cost-effective and provide better long-term protection for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider repair for minor, isolated damage; opt for replacement if multiple sections are missing or the existing siding is extensively deteriorated.
